keyboard_type.tip: Normal Input: simulates keystrokes using Windows keyboard messages; Clipboard Input: pastes clipboard content; Key Combination: uses keyboard symbol combinations for shortcut input; Driver Input: uses a driver to simulate keystrokes, suitable for online banking password fields or other scenarios where normal input fails

simulate_flag.title: Simulate Human Input
simulate_flag.tip: Simulates human typing by inputting characters one by one. Default is No
